import sys
import heapq

def main():
    data = list(map(int, sys.stdin.buffer.read().split()))
    it = iter(data)

    N = next(it)
    T = next(it)

    types = [next(it) for _ in range(N)]
    prices = [next(it) for _ in range(N)]

    C = next(it)
    customers = [next(it) for _ in range(C)]

    heaps = [[] for _ in range(T + 1)]
    for t, p in zip(types, prices):
        heaps[t].append(p)

    global_heap = []
    for t in range(1, T + 1):
        if heaps[t]:
            heapq.heapify(heaps[t])
            global_heap.append((heaps[t][0], t))

    heapq.heapify(global_heap)

    total = 0

    for u in customers:
        if u == 0:
            while global_heap:
                price, t = heapq.heappop(global_heap)
                h = heaps[t]
                if h and h[0] == price:
                    heapq.heappop(h)
                    total += price
                    if h:
                        heapq.heappush(global_heap, (h[0], t))
                    break
        else:
            h = heaps[u]
            if h:
                price = heapq.heappop(h)
                total += price
                if h:
                    heapq.heappush(global_heap, (h[0], u))

    print(total)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
